gold_sql:
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.geometry
  FROM pois p
  WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-97.715155 30.344507)',4326)::geography, 1700)
    AND p.leisure = 'golf_course'
),
poi_elev AS (
  SELECT c.id, elev.z
  FROM candidates c
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, c.geometry::geometry) AS z
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, c.geometry::geometry)
    LIMIT 1
  ) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM poi_elev
WHERE z <= 240;

  FROM pois

    AND ST_Value(
      (SELECT rast FROM dem_clip),
      pois.geometry::geometry
    ) <= 240
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS golf_course_count
FROM golf_courses;
